projects.name: Chuka Water Supply Expansion
projects.note: Pipeline laying 68% complete. Delays due to wayleave acquisition disputes with landowners along the Chuka-Igambang'ombe route. Contractor has requested 6-month extension.
sources: Controller of Budget Quarterly Report Q3 FY2023/24
Tana Water Works Development Agency Progress Report Oct 2023

projects.name: Tharaka Level 4 Hospital Maternity Wing
projects.note: Facility commissioned March 2024. Equipped with 24 beds, theatre, and neonatal unit. Serves Tharaka North and South sub-counties.
sources: Tharaka-Nithi County Health Department Commissioning Report Mar 2024
Office of the Auditor-General Special Audit Report 2024

projects.name: Gatunga Primary School Classroom Block
projects.note: 4-classroom block at ring-beam level. Community contributing labour for site clearance. Expected completion December 2024.
sources: World Vision Kenya Annual Report 2023
Tharaka-Nithi County Education Office Field Visit Report Nov 2023

projects.name: Chiakariga-Igambang'ombe Road Upgrade
projects.note: Works stopped at 30% completion (June 2023). Contractor abandoned site citing non-payment of IPCs 4-6. KeRRA has terminated contract and initiated re-tendering. Critical link for farm produce transport.
sources: KeRRA Region 6 Quarterly Report Q2 FY2023/24
Office of the Auditor-General Report on Stalled Projects 2024
Daily Nation 'Stalled Roads in Tharaka' 12 July 2024

projects.name: Marimanti Sewerage System Phase 1
projects.note: Design review ongoing. Tender evaluation completed March 2024. Contractor not yet awarded. Concerns raised on design capacity for projected population growth. Only consultancy fees paid to date.
sources: WSTF Project Appraisal Report Feb 2024
Tana Water Works Board Minutes Mar 2024

projects.name: Kathwana Market Modernization
projects.note: Market shed 80% complete. Delayed by design changes for cold storage section. Original completion August 2023, now projected March 2025.
sources: County Department of Trade Quarterly Report Q4 FY2023/24
Controller of Budget Implementation Review Report 2024

projects.name: Tunyai Dispensary Upgrade to Health Centre
projects.note: Upgraded with laboratory, maternity, and pharmacy. Solar power backup installed. Serves 12,000 residents. Handed over September 2023.
sources: AMREF Kenya Annual Report 2023
Tharaka-Nithi County Health Facility Census 2024

projects.name: Mitheru Secondary School Science Lab
projects.note: Laboratory structure complete. Equipment procurement underway. Part of Safaricom Foundation's STEM education programme.
sources: Safaricom Foundation Impact Report 2023
County Education Office Monitoring Visit Report Jan 2024

projects.name: Nkondi Irrigation Scheme Rehabilitation
projects.note: Canal lining 55% complete. Delays from community disputes over water allocation schedules. Farmer training component behind schedule.
sources: NIA Project Status Report Q3 FY2023/24
The Standard 'Irrigation Woes in Tharaka' 3 March 2024

projects.name: Chuka University Teaching Hospital ICT Hub
projects.note: Digital health training facility. Fibre connectivity installed. Equipment installation 70% complete. Partnership with Ministry of Health for telemedicine.
sources: Huawei Kenya CSR Report 2023
Chuka University Council Minutes Dec 2023

projects.name: Gatue Secondary School Dormitory
projects.note: Design phase. Geotechnical survey revealed unstable soil requiring piling. Budget revision submitted. Only design consultancy paid.
sources: Plan International Kenya Programme Update Q1 2024
County Public Works Geotechnical Report Oct 2023

projects.name: Karingani Cattle Dip Rehabilitation
projects.note: Dip tank rehabilitated, crushing pen repaired, acaricide store built. Benefits 3,200 livestock keepers. Completed January 2024.
sources: County Department of Veterinary Services Report 2024
Auditor-General County Audit 2023/24

projects.name: Ishiara-Munyi Road Graveling
projects.note: Works at 15% (bush clearing only). Contractor mobilized but no gravel delivery since November 2023. KURA investigating potential fund diversion. Critical for Ishiara market access.
sources: KURA Region 4 Monitoring Report Feb 2024
Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission Preliminary Inquiry Notice 2024

projects.name: Mugwe Primary School Water Harvesting
projects.note: 4 x 10,000L tanks, guttering, and filtration installed. Serves 450 pupils. Community trained on maintenance. Completed August 2023.
sources: Water.org Kenya Impact Report 2023
School Board of Management Minutes Sep 2023

projects.name: Tharaka Technical Training Institute Workshop
projects.note: Automotive and welding workshops at roofing stage. Equipment procurement parallel track. Target completion June 2025.
sources: TVET Authority Quarterly Report Q3 FY2023/24
TTI Principal's Report to Board Mar 2024

projects.name: Kamanyaki Borehole Project
projects.note: Borehole drilled to 280m, yield 8m³/hr. Pump installation delayed by procurement of solar pumping system. Water quality tests passed.
sources: County Water Department Field Report Jan 2024
Tana Water Works Development Agency Water Quality Certificate 2024

projects.name: Chogoria Hospital ICU Unit
projects.note: Structure complete. Medical gas pipeline installation under review by Pharmacy and Poisons Board. ICU equipment procurement on hold pending certification.
sources: CHAK Health Facility Improvement Report 2023
Pharmacy and Poisons Board Inspection Report Feb 2024

projects.name: Kierera Early Childhood Development Centre
projects.note: 2 classrooms, play area, kitchen, and sanitation block. Child-friendly design. Opened January 2024. Serves 80 children ages 4-6.
sources: Equity Group Foundation Annual Report 2023
County ECDE Coordinator Monitoring Report Feb 2024

projects.name: Marimanti Solid Waste Management Site
projects.note: NEMA approval pending. EIA license application submitted October 2023. Only feasibility study and EIA consultancy paid. Land acquisition contested.
sources: NEMA Tharaka-Nithi County Correspondence 2023-24
County Environment Department Report Q4 FY2023/24

projects.name: Gakurune Footbridge
projects.note: Abutments complete. Steel truss fabrication off-site. Community labour for approach roads. Installation scheduled October 2024.
sources: Bridges to Prosperity Kenya Update Q1 2024
Area Chief's Community Mobilization Report Dec 2023

projects.name: Tunta Primary School Perimeter Fence
projects.note: Chain-link fence 600m with 2 gates. Completed June 2023. Improved school security and reduced encroachment.
sources: County Education Infrastructure Report 2023
School BOM Completion Certificate Jul 2023

projects.name: Kamweline Water Pan Desilting
projects.note: Desilting 60% complete. Equipment breakdowns and fuel supply delays. Critical for 2,500 livestock during dry season.
sources: NDMA Drought Intervention Report 2024
County Livestock Office Field Assessment Mar 2024

projects.name: Chuka County Hospital Oxygen Plant
projects.note: Plant housing complete. Oxygen generator delivered. Installation and commissioning scheduled August 2024. Will serve 5 facilities in region.
sources: KPC Foundation CSR Report 2023
Chuka Hospital Management Board Minutes Apr 2024

projects.name: Mukothima Market Shed
projects.note: Foundation and columns only. Contractor withdrew citing escalating material costs. County legal department reviewing contract. Traders operating in open air.
sources: County Trade Department Report Q1 FY2024/25
County Assembly Public Investments Committee Minutes Feb 2024

projects.name: Nkubu-Nkondi Rural Electrification
projects.funder: Rural Electrification and Renewable Energy Corporation (REREC)
projects.note: Pole erection 75% complete. Transformer delivery delayed by 4 months. Wayleave issues in forested sections. Household connections pending backbone completion.
sources: REREC Project Monitoring Report Q3 FY2023/24
Kenya Power Wayleave Acquisition Status Jan 2024

communityNeeds.title: Kamwathu Village Borehole
communityNeeds.supportNeeded: Drilling and equipping of borehole with solar pump, storage tanks, and distribution kiosks
communityNeeds.description: Kamwathu village (approx. 1,200 residents) relies on seasonal river 5km away. Women and children spend 4-6 hours daily fetching water. Dry season causes severe shortages. Nearest functional borehole is at Kamanyaki (12km). Community has formed water committee and identified land.
sources: Chief Kamwathu Location Report 2024
Tharaka South Ward Public Participation Minutes Feb 2024

communityNeeds.title: Gakurune Dispensary
communityNeeds.supportNeeded: Construction of dispensary with outpatient, maternity, lab, pharmacy, and staff housing
communityNeeds.description: Gakurune and surrounding villages (population ~8,000) have no health facility. Nearest is Tunyai Health Centre (18km, poor roads). High maternal mortality risk. Community donated 2 acres. CHVs active but need facility for referrals and deliveries.
sources: Tharaka North Sub-County Health Profile 2023
Area MCA Ward Development Forum Report 2024

communityNeeds.title: Kathangachini ECDE Centre
communityNeeds.supportNeeded: Two classrooms, sanitation block, play area, and feeding programme kitchen
communityNeeds.description: Current ECDE operates in borrowed church hall. 65 children ages 4-5. No sanitation, no feeding programme. Parents contribute but insufficient. Land available adjacent to primary school. County ECDE policy supports community-initiated centres.
sources: County ECDE Baseline Survey 2023
Kathangachini Primary School BOM Proposal 2024
